donor_products_specified.donor_product: Ideal donor product over the registered family: retrieval/reasoning research agent, Co-Scientist-style multi-agent hypothesis evolution, AlphaEvolve-style evaluator-guided program evolution, domain-native autonomous discovery agent, and their legal compositions (NEAREST_WORK section 4 items 1-5).
Per-donor singleton explanation families plus their pairwise unions executed on the identical corpus, i.e. the atlas without ideal-product composition.
Unguarded / scalar-benchmark admission baseline: the same campaign decisions made by a leaderboard-style admission rule with the guard layer removed.
Strong debugging/research agents (root-cause baselines over the same incident telemetry) per the RESPONSIBILITY_DIAGNOSIS atom superiority target.
Manifest-level identity donors: pinned versions, content hashes and generic numerical canaries (the NUMERICAL_OUTCOME_IDENTITY atom superiority target names them explicitly).
Fixed-morphology search, fair-dovetail enumeration (RN-T8 schedule) and AlphaEvolve-style evaluator-guided evolution, all under identical world access and evaluation budget.
Vocabulary/embedding analogy transfer (embedding similarity retrieval plus surface-mapped reuse), the donor named in the STRUCTURAL_TRANSFER atom superiority target.
Donor grammar: the strongest registered formal-tool automation (proof-assistant tactic/hammer stacks) executed on the identical escrowed problem at matched compute and interface access.
Reliability-matched alternative stack (classical or alternative quantum) executed on the identical workload and decision stream.
Literature-scan donor: a strong retrieval/reading agent producing the same parent-to-atom matrix without source adjudication, at matched reading budget.
Strong general research agents (frontier agent baselines) on the identical blinded panel.
Naive-diff donor: plain textual/structural diff between manuscript claims and ledger atoms with no validation gating.
Refreshed external literature/search baseline: the nearest-work absorption family refreshed at review time, executed against the final residual family.

donor_rule: FD-T5 first refusal + NEAREST_WORK_ABSORPTION_AND_RESIDUAL_V1.md section 4: every residual claim is refused until the information-matched donor product has run under the same contract.
